name: GrantOgre
tagline: Finds currently-open funding programmes and prepares the application pack
description: Searches for funding programmes that are currently open and genuinely fit the applicant, whether that is a business, a nonprofit, or a client project you are running. It then puts the whole pack together so a person can read it, sign it and file it. Nothing is ever submitted on its own.
